newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa, Solomon Islands set up diplomatic ties.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa, Solomon Islands set up diplomatic ties.

text.p: South Africa announced on Thursday it had established diplomatic relations with the Solomon Islands in the South Pacific.
The Foreign Affairs Department in Pretoria said ties at ambassadorial level had been agreed and it hoped closer links would promote mutual benefits in commerce, economics and culture.

The announcement was made just a few weeks after South Africa said it was breaking official ties with Taiwan in favour of Beijing, leaving the Solomon Islands as one of just 29 countries with diplomatic relations with Taipei.
